name: Halo Antenna
description: The Halo antenna is a horizontally polarized omnidirectional loop used primarily on VHF. It is essentially a folded dipole bent into a circle, often gamma-matched for 50-ohm feed, and is popular for mobile weak-signal work.
modelingNotes: Loop diameter determines resonant frequency and radiation pattern.
Conductor diameter affects bandwidth and Q factor.
Gamma match length controls feedpoint impedance.
Horizontal polarization provides better weak-signal performance.
Mounting height influences horizon gain and pattern symmetry.
